claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used in production to make PET plastic bottles of different sizes.
claims.evidence: The witness photos show an industrial enclosure with open front panels and a control/display area, but the exact machine type/function and any bottle-making capability are not readable or confirmed.

risks.risk: Exact machine type/function is unclear (could be related equipment, not a bottle-making line). This directly affects market value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the machine’s nameplate/label showing brand, model, and function (or a wide shot showing the full production setup and output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified industrial plastic-bottle-related machine with unknown function/outputs.

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (cannot confirm it powers on, runs, heats, cycles, and produces bottles).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, control panel startup, running cycle, and a finished bottle output (or test run).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/unknown working condition (worst case: not working or needs repair).

risks.risk: Missing parts or wear inside (hoses/tubing, belts, sensors, wiring, guards) could require replacement.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of all internal components with emphasis on hoses/tubing ends, sensors, wiring condition, and any missing/loose parts; plus a close-up of the open doors/panels from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/needs servicing due to unknown internal condition.

risks.risk: Power requirements/compatibility unknown (voltage/phase, connectors). Buyer may need electrical work or adapters.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the electrical specifications plate (voltage, phase, frequency, power rating) and the inlet/connector type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring verification and possible electrical adaptation.

risks.risk: Age/usage hours and maintenance history unknown; may be near end-of-life.
risks.proof: Photos of maintenance logs (if any), hour meter reading (if present), and any service stickers/records; plus close-ups of wear points.

risks.risk: Accessories/spares not included or incomplete (dies/molds, filters, spare parts, manuals).
risks.proof: A photo inventory list showing included accessories/spares (molds/dies, hoses, filters, manuals, tools) laid out and labeled.
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine only, with no guaranteed spares/manuals.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the machine nameplate/label (brand, model, and exact function).
Video: power-on and a full operating cycle on the control panel (showing it runs).
Video or photo evidence of output: finished PET bottles (showing size range claimed).
Close-up photos of internal components: hoses/tubing, sensors, wiring, pumps/heaters (if present), and any wear/damage.
Photo of electrical specifications plate (voltage/phase/frequency) and the power inlet/connector type.
Photos of included accessories/spares (especially any molds/dies, filters, manuals) and what is missing.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an industrial enclosure with internal components and a control area, but the exact bottle-making function, brand/model, and working condition are not verifiable from the provided report. Without proof of type and operation, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
